coefficient_source: FC branch alpha/beta coefficients recomputed from frozen selected hyperparameters using _solve_msancr_kernel + recover_msancr_beta for FP models, and Ridge.coef_ for FC-no-prior
coefficient_treatment: absolute values of primal beta coefficients (beta_fc)
prior_vector: Each model measured against the MATCHED task prior (not its own prior) for specificity
similarity_statistic: Spearman rank correlation between ROI-level importance vector and matched task prior vector
fold_aggregation: Per-fold ROI importance computed from absolute beta coefficients aggregated to ROI level by summing absolute edge weights per ROI and dividing by (n_rois - 1)
seed_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-fold Spearman correlations within each seed, then arithmetic mean across 10 seeds
top_k_definition: Top-10 ROI indices by absolute importance, compared via Jaccard index against top-10 ROIs of matched task prior
distinction_self_vs_matched: self_prior_alignment = correlation with the prior used to train that specific model; matched_task_prior_alignment = correlation with the task-matched prior across all models (used for fairness)
professor_facing_comparison: All models compared against the same matched_task_prior_alignment to ensure fair cross-model comparison
biomarker_limitation: Coefficients were not saved in the final run; they are recomputed from the exact frozen hyperparameters and splits. No new fitting or hyperparameter selection occurred.
